name: Katzenkopf-Hütte
kurzbeschreibung:
**Katzenkopf Hut** in **Tirol** is a cozy mountain refuge nestled at **1,870 meters** above sea level, offering breathtaking views of the **Zillertal Alps**. Whether you're hiking, skiing, or simply enjoying the alpine air, this charming hut is the perfect retreat.

The **Katzenkopf Hut** welcomes you with hearty **Tiroler** hospitality. Savor traditional dishes like **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Käsespätzle**, or a warm bowl of **Tiroler Gröstl** after a long day on the trails. The rustic ambiance and friendly service make every visit unforgettable.

In winter, the hut serves as a starting point for fantastic ski tours, while summer brings endless hiking opportunities. Don’t miss the chance to relax with a **Tiroler** beer or **Schnaps** on the sunny terrace, soaking in the stunning scenery.

Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, the **Katzenkopf Hut** is easily accessible, making it an ideal destination for a day trip or an overnight stay. Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or a first-time visitor, this alpine gem promises an authentic **Tiroler** experience.
